body.name: Sixty-four-branch families
body.construction: Let \(u_{K0}(x)=Kx\), \(u_{K1}(x)=1-(1-x)/K\), \(d_{K0}(x)=x/K\), and \(d_{K1}(x)=1-K(1-x)\). For \(\beta\in\{0,1\}^6\) and \(\ell\in\{0,1\}\), define \(r_{\ell\beta}^+=e_\ell p_\ell+(1-e_\ell)u_{G,\beta_\ell}(p_\ell)\), \(t_{\ell\beta}^+=u_{B,\beta_{2+\ell}}(r_{\ell\beta}^+)\), \(r_{\ell\beta}^-=e_\ell p_\ell+(1-e_\ell)d_{G,\beta_\ell}(p_\ell)\), and \(t_{\ell\beta}^-=d_{B,\beta_{2+\ell}}(r_{\ell\beta}^-)\). Put \(h_\beta=d_{C,\beta_5}(q_0)\) if \(\beta_4=0\), and \(h_\beta=u_{C,\beta_5}(q_0)\) if \(\beta_4=1\). For \(s\in\{-,+\}\), set \(f_\beta^s(P)=a\sum_{\ell=0}^1q_\ell r_{\ell\beta}^s+(1-a)\{h_\beta t_{0\beta}^s+(1-h_\beta)t_{1\beta}^s\}\). The set \(\mathcal B_+(P)\) imposes \(u_{G,\beta_\ell}(p_\ell)\leq u_{G,1-\beta_\ell}(p_\ell)\) and \(u_{B,\beta_{2+\ell}}(r_{\ell\beta}^+)\leq u_{B,1-\beta_{2+\ell}}(r_{\ell\beta}^+)\) for both strata; it also imposes \(d_{C,\beta_5}(q_0)\geq d_{C,1-\beta_5}(q_0)\) when \(\beta_4=0\), \(u_{C,\beta_5}(q_0)\leq u_{C,1-\beta_5}(q_0)\) when \(\beta_4=1\), and \(t_{0\beta}^+\leq t_{1\beta}^+\) when \(\beta_4=0\) or \(t_{0\beta}^+\geq t_{1\beta}^+\) when \(\beta_4=1\). The set \(\mathcal B_-(P)\) replaces the first four inequalities by the corresponding \(d_G\)- and \(d_B\)-piece inequalities with \(\geq\), keeps the stated \(d_C\)- and \(u_C\)-piece inequalities, and imposes \(t_{0\beta}^-\geq t_{1\beta}^-\) when \(\beta_4=0\) or \(t_{0\beta}^-\leq t_{1\beta}^-\) when \(\beta_4=1\). All inequalities are weak, and \(F_s(P)=f_\beta^s(P)\) for every \(\beta\in\mathcal B_s(P)\).
